meta.source: Reconciled from the Notion 'ETA Design System (Claude Design): Token and Component Inventory' (2026-10-06), the era-app index.css and the Investor Pitch Template deck. Not read from the Claude Design project itself (login required); re-sync from there when possible. Mark tokens (mark-*, band-dark, on-band-dark*, gold-light, gold-deep) added 2026-10-09 with the proposed logo.

tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Page and slide background. Always set per section.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Secondary panel, tag and band fill, one step off paper.

tokens.name: card
tokens.usage: Elevated cards and table bodies on paper or surface.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines, table rules, card borders.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on paper, surface and card.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary body text on paper, surface and card.

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Footers, page numbers, source lines. Not for anything read closely.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Royal Blue (ratified 2026-08-18). Fills, buttons, big numerals, links at 24px and up. Text under 24px uses accent-strong.

tokens.name: accent-strong
tokens.usage: Royal Blue for text under 24px on paper, surface or card.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text on accent-fill (buttons and small labels, 4.63:1 light). On the ratified Royal Blue itself only at 24px and up or bold, as the README records.

tokens.name: accent-fill
tokens.usage: Royal Blue fill behind on-accent text under 24px (primary Button, accent fills with white labels): 4.63:1 light, 7.43:1 dark. accent itself stays the ratified #1d73ed for everything else. Added 2026-10-10.

tokens.name: accent-tint
tokens.usage: Pill, tag and callout fill behind accent-strong text.

tokens.name: gold
tokens.usage: Bullion and ceremonial accent: gold Badge tone and the right face of the ceremonial gold mark (on band-dark). Decorative. Do not pair with blue (rule recorded 2026-10-06); it pairs with silver, which has no token yet.

tokens.name: letter-e
tokens.usage: The E of ETA in the wordmark only. Legacy: the proposed mark of 2026-10-09 does not use the letter colours; keep for legacy material until the logo is ratified.

tokens.name: letter-t
tokens.usage: The T of ETA in the wordmark only. Legacy: the proposed mark of 2026-10-09 does not use the letter colours; keep for legacy material until the logo is ratified.

tokens.name: letter-a
tokens.usage: The A of ETA in the wordmark only. Legacy: the proposed mark of 2026-10-09 does not use the letter colours; keep for legacy material until the logo is ratified.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Positive status text. Always with a word or icon.

tokens.name: success-bg
tokens.usage: Fill behind success text.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Pending or caution status text. Always with a word or icon.

tokens.name: warning-bg
tokens.usage: Fill behind warning text.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Blocked or failed status text. Always with a word or icon.

tokens.name: danger-bg
tokens.usage: Fill behind danger text.

tokens.name: on-gold
tokens.usage: Text placed on a gold fill (the gold Badge tone). Dark in both themes because ink inverts in the dark theme and would fail on gold. Added 2026-10-08.

tokens.name: mark-facet-light
tokens.usage: Left face of the mark (lit side). In the mark only.

tokens.name: mark-facet-mid
tokens.usage: Right face of the mark; equals accent in the light theme. In the mark only.

tokens.name: mark-facet-deep
tokens.usage: Bottom face of the mark (shadow side). In the mark only; also a cover block.

tokens.name: mark-reversed-light
tokens.usage: Left face of the mark on band-dark, in either theme.

tokens.name: mark-reversed-mid
tokens.usage: Right face of the mark on band-dark, in either theme.

tokens.name: mark-reversed-deep
tokens.usage: Bottom face of the mark on band-dark, in either theme; a cropped mark on banners.

tokens.name: band-dark
tokens.usage: Background, not text: a fixed dark band that stays dark in both themes, behind the reversed logo, business-card front, avatars and statement bands. Text on it is on-band-dark (12.28:1 dark) or on-band-dark-muted (6.98:1 dark). Lifted above card in the dark theme so the band stays visible against the page. Renamed from ink-band on 2026-10-10; value unchanged.

tokens.name: on-band-dark
tokens.usage: Text and one-colour logo on band-dark.

tokens.name: on-band-dark-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on band-dark.

tokens.name: gold-light
tokens.usage: Lit face of the ceremonial gold mark. On band-dark only, never beside blue.

tokens.name: gold-deep
tokens.usage: Shadow face of the ceremonial gold mark. On band-dark only, never beside blue.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Uppercase label above a heading. The token says 11px but the component and specimens use 12px; this system adopts 12px.

styles.name: slide-body
styles.usage: Primary slide body copy. Never below 24px on a slide.

styles.name: slide-label
styles.usage: Eyebrows (uppercase, 4px tracking), footers, page numbers, captions.

styles.name: slide-stat
styles.usage: Big number on a stat card.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Hairline gaps, icon padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Tight gaps inside a component.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Small gaps between related items.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Default gap, card padding on screens.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card padding, gap between cards on a slide.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between slide blocks.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Section gaps.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Large section gaps; footer offset on a slide.

tokens.name: margin-slide
tokens.usage: Left and right slide margin on a 1920x1080 canvas.

spacing.note: 4px is the working base unit in the Claude Design scale (space-1 here equals the project's space-2). The Style Guide says 8px; that is an open decision recorded in Notion.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Chips, inputs.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards and images (base 0.5rem).

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Large cards, panels.

tokens.name: radius-2xl
tokens.usage: Hero panels, slide cards.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Badges, tags, CTAs.
